class.name: IfcCurveStyleFont
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : A curve style font combines several curve style font pattern entities into a more complex pattern. The resulting pattern is repeated along the curve. NOTE: Corresponding ISO 10303 name: curve_style_font. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-46:1994 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORY: New entity in IFC2x2.

members.member: Name that may be assigned with the curve font.
A list of curve font pattern entities, that contains the simple patterns used for drawing curves. The patterns are applied in the order they occur in the list.
